trajectory_summary: A short, procedurally clean DQ call that ends with an unresolved thread. The rep correctly identified the manufactured-home hard gate and didn't waste time pretending otherwise, but the customer's clarifying question about trailers-as-manufactured-homes was left hanging as the call fizzled to a close. Energy neither built nor collapsed dramatically — it stalled on an unanswered question.

observed_outcome.reasoning: Customer's disclosure of manufactured-home status triggers Ion's hard DQ gate per dq_rules; the rep confirmed the DQ at 01:24 and the call ended without any appointment or next step.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The call was disqualified on home-type before verify reached the bill-collection stage; no bill or usage figure was ever discussed.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The call never reached the interest-question portion of verify; it was disqualified on home type within the first two questions after address confirmation.

script_coverage.quote: Hey, Joe. This is Holland with Ion. I just heard that you're looking to your home.
I've got your address here, as 1511 Jones Road in Kershaw, South Carolina. Is that correct?
is this a manufactured home or a single family home?

primary_coaching_focus.quote: Okay. A trailer is considered a manufactured home. Right?
primary_coaching_focus.why: The rep let a direct, simple clarifying question go unanswered as the call ended — a one-line answer costs nothing and this is a repeatable, fixable habit for a DQ call.

key_moments.quote: So I just helped get those estimates put together for the home.
key_moments.stewart_read: The intro skips company context (state, lead source, why calling) beyond naming Ion and referencing prior estimates. It's brief but doesn't fully answer 'is this legitimate' before diving into verify.

key_moments.quote: So we we actually can't work with manufactured homes, unfortunately.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is not a violation — this is the CORRECT execution of a hard DQ per Ion's manufactured-home gate. Flagging it here to confirm the rep did not try to push a disqualified lead into an appointment.

key_moments.quote: Why can't you guys work with the manufacturer home?
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer wants the real reason. Rep gives a plausible-sounding technical explanation (panel weight working into walls) but it's delivered hesitantly and never circles back when challenged on terminology.

key_moments.quote: make any, like, home damages or anything to you.
key_moments.stewart_read: The explanation is delivered with hedging filler ('like,' 'or anything') that undercuts the authority of the DQ reasoning, right at the moment the customer is pushing for clarity.
